honest_limits: Overlap counts accessions with a FINITE value that appear in the genotype matrix; it does NOT check the phenotype is quantitative-continuous, nor that it is independent of the others (many AraPheno traits come from one study and are correlated).
A high overlap does not make a trait a good calibration target. Several of these are binary/ordinal scores, which a ridge will handle poorly.
Failures are RECORDED, never counted as zero-overlap -- a fetch failure and an empty phenotype must not look alike.
